name: five-exit-lenses
description: A buyer's-eye read of a board pack, business plan or strategy document through five fixed lenses.

interface.longDescription:
See your business the way a potential buyer would.

For owners, CEOs, chairs and investors preparing a company for sale, when exit readiness is on the agenda.

Share a board pack, business plan or strategy document and Five Exit Lenses identifies what would strengthen or weaken a buyer's confidence in the business: what your document evidences, what it only claims, what important evidence is missing, and the questions a buyer is likely to ask.

It works inside ChatGPT and gives you a quick buyer's-eye read of where the business looks convincing today, and where a buyer would want stronger evidence.

What the service does
Five Exit Lenses reads your document through five areas a buyer would examine:
- Revenue Quality: how dependable and defensible the revenue appears.
- Right to Win: whether there is evidence of genuine competitive advantage.
- Platform Optionality: whether there are credible avenues for future growth.
- Scalable Economics: whether growth translates into attractive economics.
- Execution Credibility: whether the evidence supports confidence in management's ability to deliver.

For each lens, it distinguishes evidence from assertion, identifies what is missing, and surfaces the questions a buyer would ask next.

It needs no separate account and involves no human service.

Your document is never sent to or retained by Five Exit Lenses; only minimal pseudonymous usage metadata is kept for the stated period, and follow-up request wording only with your explicit consent. Not financial, legal, investment or transaction advice.

positive.prompt:
Here is our August board pack. Read it the way a buyer would.

# Northbridge Payments Ltd — Board Pack, August 2026 (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, FICTIONAL COMPANY)

## CEO summary
August revenue £4.1m, a record, 7% below plan. Net revenue retention 112% on a trailing twelve month basis. Pipeline "strongest ever". Two enterprise logos signed (contract values not stated). Churn "in line with expectations".

## Financials
| | Aug act | Aug plan | YTD act | YTD plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 4.1 | 4.4 | 30.2 | 32.0 |
| Gross margin % | 61% | 64% | 62% | 64% |
| EBITDA | 0.3 | 0.6 | 2.1 | 3.4 |
| Cash | 6.8 | | | |

Marketing spend up 40% YoY to drive volume. CAC payback "improving" (no figure). Top 10 customers: share of revenue not disclosed in this pack.

## Product
New reconciliation module launched. Adoption: 14 of 210 customers. Roadmap: AI fraud scoring in Q4, pending data partner agreement.

## People
CFO on leave from September; interim cover by FP&A lead. Head of Sales vacancy open 5 months.

## Risks
EU distance-selling rules may affect 9% of revenue. Single hosting provider. Key-customer contract (largest account) renews in March 2027; "conversations positive".
FIXTURE-TOKEN-BP-7Q2X
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_document once with document_type board_pack. Returns: document read line; five lens blocks (Revenue Quality, Right to Win, Platform Optionality, Scalable Economics, Execution Credibility) each with EVIDENCE, INFERENCE, MISSING and QUESTION; three items a buyer discounts first; closing evidence line; the fixed disclaimer footer. Figures such as NRR 112% are treated as claims; no invented numbers.

positive.prompt:
Read this three-year business plan through the five lenses.

# Harbourline Care Group — Business Plan 2027–2029 (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, FICTIONAL COMPANY)

Harbourline operates 11 residential care homes. Revenue 2026E £38m, EBITDA £5.9m. Plan: £62m revenue and £11.5m EBITDA by 2029 through four acquisitions and occupancy from 86% to 93%.

Assumptions: fee growth 5% p.a. (local authority fee growth historically 2–3%); agency staff cost falling from 14% to 6% of payroll; acquisitions at 6x EBITDA funded 60% debt; CQC ratings maintained at Good across all homes (two currently Requires Improvement).

Management: CEO founder, 22 years; Finance Director joined 2025; no COO. Board: founder, FD, one investor director.

Evidence attached: 2026 management accounts (unaudited), occupancy by home, staff turnover 31%. Not attached: customer or commissioner contracts, acquisition pipeline detail, CQC reports.
FIXTURE-TOKEN-BIZ-9K4M
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_document with document_type business_plan. Same output structure; fee-growth and agency-cost assumptions flagged against stated history; missing contracts and CQC reports listed as MISSING.

positive.prompt:
This is our strategy refresh. What would a buyer make of it?

# Veltrix Software — Strategy Refresh, FY27 (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, FICTIONAL COMPANY)

Vision: the operating system for mid-market logistics. Three pillars: (1) land-and-expand in existing 340 accounts; (2) launch usage-based pricing; (3) enter DACH via partner channel.

Targets: ARR from €21m to €40m in three years; gross retention above 92% (current 88%, stated as "improving"); rule of 40 by FY29.

Initiatives: 27 listed, none prioritised, no owners named, no dated milestones. Investment ask €6m over two years for product and partner team. Expected return: "significant".

Competitive view: two named competitors described as "legacy"; no win/loss data. Customer evidence: three quotes, unattributed. Pricing test: planned, not run.
FIXTURE-TOKEN-STRAT-3N8R
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_document with document_type strategy_document. Same output structure; 27 unprioritised initiatives without owners or dates, untested pricing and unattributed quotes surfaced as MISSING evidence.
